entry.title: 1 in 13 adults under 30 already had hidden artery plaque
entry.summary: More than half of 16,000 apparently healthy adults had signs of atherosclerosis, with arterial plaques already detectable in about 1 in 13 people ages 18 to 29. Researchers say directly imaging the arteries could reveal hidden cardiovascular disease years or even decades before symptoms appear.

entry.title: Leucine does more than build muscle. It powers up your cells

The discovery reveals a new connection between nutrition and metabolism that could eventually lead to new approaches for metabolic disorders and cancer.

entry.title: New Cardio Safe Initiative Aims to Advance Safer, More Respectful Clinical Care Environments
entry.summary: ACC's new Cardio Safe initiative, launching this fall, will help cardiologists and cardiovascular professionals address patient- and visitor-initiated mistreatment while fostering safer, more respectful and psychologically secure clinical care environments.
